content.section_title: 4.3 Investigations to determine the underlying aetiology of chronic heart failure
content.summary: Recommended tests to determine the underlying aetiology of chronic heart failure (CHF) including use of natriuretic peptides for diagnosis, and imaging modalities to identify ischaemia, myocardial fibrosis/scar, infiltrative and genetic cardiomyopathies.

BNP.role: Used as a rule-out threshold for heart failure in the non-acute setting

NT-proBNP.role: Used as a rule-out threshold for heart failure in the non-acute setting

MR-proANP.role: Fewer data available than for BNP/NT-proBNP
MR-proANP.rule_out_cutoff: <40 pmol/L (can be used to rule out HF)

imaging_recommendations.stress_echocardiography: Exercise or pharmacological stress echocardiography may be used to assess inducible ischaemia in patients considered suitable for coronary revascularization; may help clarify diagnosis in HFpEF, valve disease, or unexplained dyspnoea.

uses: Late gadolinium enhancement (LGE), T1 mapping and extracellular volume to identify myocardial fibrosis/scar
Differentiate ischaemic heart disease (subendocardial scar) from dilated cardiomyopathy (mid-wall scar)
Characterisation of myocarditis, amyloidosis, sarcoidosis, Chagas disease, Fabry disease, left ventricular non-compaction, haemochromatosis, arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy

imaging_recommendations.computed_tomography_coronary_angiography: May be considered in patients with low-to-intermediate pre-test probability of CAD or equivocal non-invasive stress tests to exclude CAD.
imaging_recommendations.single_photon_emission_CT (SPECT): Can assess myocardial ischaemia, viability, inflammation or infiltration; technetium-labelled bisphosphonate scintigraphy has high sensitivity and specificity for imaging cardiac transthyretin amyloid.
imaging_recommendations.coronary_angiography: Recommended in patients with HF who have angina (or angina-equivalent) despite medical therapy to establish diagnosis and severity of CAD; may be considered in HFrEF with intermediate-high pre-test probability of CAD.
